# Large Codebase Reverse Engineering & Refactoring

Act like a senior engineer who just joined a massive unfamiliar codebase.

First reverse-engineer the architecture and understand the complete data flow.

Identify:
- Bad architecture decisions
- Duplicate logic
- Performance bottlenecks
- Scalability risks
- Maintainability issues

Finally provide:
- Clean architecture breakdown
- Critical problem areas
- Refactoring strategies
- Improved production-grade code

Do not change functionality. Only upgrade code quality, scalability, and maintainability.
